chapters.title: A quick recap and one open question

takeaways: Compliance Manager in Microsoft Purview runs on three parts: assessments as report cards, improvement actions as the to-do list and the compliance score that ties them together.
More than 360 regulatory templates and the default Data Protection Baseline mean you start from a library instead of mapping regulations by hand.
The compliance score tracks progress on recommended, risk-weighted actions, including Microsoft's share of the work; it is not a certificate of compliance.
hook: When leadership asks whether the company is actually compliant, most teams answer with a shrug and a pile of spreadsheets. This episode explains Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager for admins, security and compliance beginners: the compliance score, assessments, templates, improvement actions and roles. You will learn how to turn compliance into a steady, measurable routine.
